scheme_name: Award Of Incentive For Marriage Between Persons With Benchmark Disabilities & Other Person
other_conditions: Both spouses must be residents of Odisha State
The bridegroom must be at least 21 years old and the bride at least 18 years old at the time of marriage
Neither spouse should have previously availed the incentive under this scheme
The incentive is payable to either spouse who has a benchmark disability (disability ≥40%) when married to a non‑disabled person
Beneficiaries must choose a single department (either ST & SC Development, Minorities, and Backward Class Welfare Department or the Department of SSEPD) to avoid duplication
The incentive amount is locked for 3 years with phased withdrawals (10% after 6 months, another 10% after one year, and the remaining 80% after 3 years)
benefits_summary: A cash incentive of ₹2,50,000 is disbursed to the couple, locked for three years with phased withdrawals.
